part.text:
Fixed the issue in `tsdb/head_append.go` (`appendPreprocessor`): when the head chunk is cut due to reaching the byte-size limit, an out-of-order sample whose timestamp is already covered by the current chunk (`c.maxTime >= t`) is now discarded instead of being appended into the freshly cut chunk, which previously created duplicate/overlapping samples across chunk boundaries.

Validation: `TestHead*`, `TestDB*`, and duplicate/append-related tests all pass.
